profile.summary: i3DigitalPD provides online professional development for educators. It offers training for teachers, school and program administrators, and content designers who work in online, hybrid and blended learning settings. Its team includes former online educators, instructional designers and administrators from the Clark County School District in Las Vegas, Nevada.
